notes.title: NEW UPDATE: POWERUPS ARE HERE!!!
notes.content:
Hello fans!

The latest version updated on May 5th adds brand new gameplay in the form of....POWERUPS!!

Besides asteroids, we now have colored crystals. Your ball transforms into the powerup reward based on the colored crystal that you collide with. There are 3 powerups:

Detonate: This powerup allows you to spawn 4 extra balls when you press the trigger to allow for more chained destruction.

Steer: This powerup lets you steer the ball for a limited time.

Multiply: This powerup gives you 2x your points for all destroyed asteroids within the time limit.

We also have a new chained multiplier that increases after every asteroid that's hit before the ball comes back to you. 2 asteroids = 2x, 3 = 3x, etc. 

This should provide for a wider range of scores in the leaderboard!

Enjoy!

notes.title: New Update Live: Asteroid respawn
notes.content:
Hello all,

We've made an update to the build over the weekend which fixes Asteroid respawn so that you have the same number of asteroids at Play start every time. 

The prior version would not respawn the asteroids and after several play sessions players would notice that the number of asteroids would diminish. This would affect your potential high score. 

Also looking forward to adding support for Oculus Rift in coming week. 

Thanks all for playing!

-ZmeAdmin
